easy: A little easier than an even game; the best level for learning
standard: A little tougher than an even game
hard: About as strong as the app's rivals
method: Each cell is 360 games on seeds (block 200000) not used to tune the rules, played with v0.3.8. Lower means tougher rivals. In a perfectly even game the player would win 33% against two rivals, 25% against three, 20% against four and 17% against five.
strategy: **Strategy balance.** Chasing Domination cards is the strongest approach in testing: at Standard it wins 13–43% against paper rivals versus 5–20% for spreading out or chasing majorities. At Hard and Expert the three approaches even out. If you want a harder game, avoid leaning on Domination cards, or move up a level.
stalls: With the Barren Earth step, no test game stalled: every game reached a normal end. If the action display fills before every rival has placed, Planning simply ends and the extra pawns wait for the next turn.
